title: Opening of the interview at Carter's home
summary: Levy introduces the Smithsonian oral history session at Ron Carter's home and Carter agrees to follow her questions.

blocks.x: Funding for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program NEA Jazz Master interview was provided by the National Endowment for the Arts.
Interviewer: Devra Hall Levy with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 44 pp.

It's May 16th, we're sitting in the home of Ron Carter, Jazz Master, to get the oral history for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Project. Ron, this is your story so please feel free to take it in any direction that you want as I go.
